definitions.explanation: Temperature below zero degrees, typically Celsius. Used when stating temperatures below the freezing point.

examples.english: It was minus 5 degrees this morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{零下|れいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧。
examples.english: When the temperature drops below zero, water pipes freeze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{零下|れいか}20⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, temperatures can drop below minus 20 degrees in winter.

notes:
USAGE:
Used before a number to indicate a temperature below zero: {零下|れいか}10⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (minus 10 degrees). ⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧ is also commonly used in spoken Japanese for the same purpose.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {零下|れいか}～⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (minus ~ degrees)
- {零下|れいか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to drop below zero)
- {零下|れいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧ (to record sub-zero temperatures)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マイナス→マイナス：00268_mainasu⟧: minus — loanword, commonly used in spoken Japanese
- ⟦{氷点下|ひょうてんか}→氷点下：07669_hyoutenka⟧: below freezing point — more formal, specifically refers to below 0°C
